breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.0005 with 720 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.3.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the final time (T=0.3), the time step (dt=0.0005), and the number of steps (720). It correctly recalculated the number of steps needed to be 600 (0.3 / 0.0005 = 600) and stated this in the generated specification, matching the ground truth.
